# conn2res simulation and readout modules

This folder contains the unmodified simulation and readout modules from [netneurolab/conn2res at commit 3ccb7074261c910847dcd0164b00ff3b02bade90](https://github.com/netneurolab/conn2res/tree/3ccb7074261c910847dcd0164b00ff3b02bade90). Its BSD license is in `LICENSE`. The analysis adds this directory to the Python search path before importing `conn2res.reservoir`.
